line: One fictional object of glass, metal and light in an infinite black studio; every move lands on the beat.
line_cn: 一个虚构的玻璃金属物体悬浮在无限黑色影棚里，每一次运镜都落在节拍上。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: A single hero object floating in black; long light strips behind and beside it.
Clear glass reads as thin white outlines with rainbow edges; internals show through.
Brushed metal, frosted shells, light that travels inside channels.
Slow, precise, beat-locked motion; every cut on a bar line.
The object is always fictional: no real product silhouette, name or logo.
not: Not a white-cyclorama catalogue shot: the ground is black.
Not a wireframe HUD: material and light are the subject.
Not a keynote slide: no text, no bullets.
materials: Glass with dispersion; frosted glass that clears; brushed and polished metal.
Strip lights reflected as long highlights; a mirror floor with soft caustics.
Internal emissive channels: data, charge, heat as light.

rules: Black ground, white strips, one accent light colour inside the object.
Rainbow dispersion only at thick glass edges.
colour.examplePalette: black #050506, strip white #f4f4f0, accent #2fd8ff or #ff6a3d, metal #b9bcc2

type.titleFont: a light geometric sans, wide tracking, white
type.placement: a claim or a number in negative space after a pull-back; the assembler adds it
rules: Type only in shots with room for it; never over the object.
Everything slow and precise; a light sweep or a pulse marks each beat.
Parts float apart and snap back on a downbeat.
No spatial continuity needed between shots: each is its own stage.

grammar.note: a sweep over a dark object

grammar.expresses: the whole object in one move

grammar.note: macro, rack focus shell → part inside

framing: One hero, centred or on a strong diagonal, never cropped in a wide.

foley: a glass tick on each highlight
a soft magnetic snap for parts closing
sound.silence: one bar of nothing before the snap or the reveal
sound.voice: a calm, low voice saying very little, or none
sound.musicDefault: minimal electronic, sub and mallets, beat-locked

nativeMoves.name: Transparency
nativeMoves.what: The inside is the hero; rack focus from shell to part within.
nativeMoves.build: dof rack, camera static, beat names the two subjects.

nativeMoves.name: Light that travels inside
nativeMoves.what: Energy runs as light through channels.
nativeMoves.build: beats: 'a cyan pulse travels from the base through the channel to the tip'; vfx bloom.

nativeMoves.name: Exploded view and snap
nativeMoves.what: Parts float apart and snap back on a downbeat.
nativeMoves.build: two beats in one shot; cut before the snap on the bar line.

nativeMoves.name: Frost to clear
nativeMoves.what: A frosted shell clears and the inside appears.
nativeMoves.build: beat 'the frosted shell turns clear from the top down'.

nativeMoves.name: Caustic ring
nativeMoves.what: An internal pulse becomes a ring on the floor.
nativeMoves.build: tilt to top-down, loop link for a repeating pulse.

pitfalls.problem: The object resembles a real brand's product.
pitfalls.fix: Describe a fictional silhouette in the prop element; negatives 'no logos, no real products'.

pitfalls.problem: The background gains a gradient or a room.
pitfalls.fix: Say 'infinite black studio, only strip lights' in every beat suffix.
Name 'thick clear glass with rainbow dispersion at the edges, internals visible'.

look.genre: high-end product film, glass and metal in a black studio, beat-locked
look.palette: black ground, white light strips, one accent light inside the object, rainbow dispersion at edges
look.camera: slow orbits, macro rack focus, pull-backs into negative space
look.lighting: long strip lights behind and beside the object, mirror floor, no fill

engine.beatSuffix: A fictional glass-and-metal object floating in an infinite black studio lit by long white strips.

structures: a line-up of three variants compared by what glows inside
one object through morning, noon and night strips
a material stack, one layer removed per beat
openings: inside first: one internal part, the shell forms around it
caustic first: light on the floor, followed up to the object
silhouettes: several dark outlines, one begins to glow
endings: floor only: the object leaves, its caustic keeps pulsing
cool down: emission fades to bare outlines
held macro: one detail, no pull-back
